functions.//: The repo's one backend: parseReceipt (receipt photo -> proposed budget line items). Deployed SEPARATELY from hosting — `firebase deploy --only functions` — and never as a rider on a hosting deploy; the hosting-only standing authorization does not cover it. Needs the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret set once via `firebase functions:secrets:set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.

rewrites.//: Scan landing. A printed QR encodes HTTPS://FEB-COMPOSITES.WEB.APP/Q/<ID> — uppercase, because QR alphanumeric mode has no lowercase and staying inside it keeps the code at 29 modules with 25% error correction instead of 33 modules with 15%. Hosting globs are case-sensitive, so both cases are listed: the uppercase one is what every label carries, the lowercase one catches a code someone typed or OCR'd by hand. Deliberately namespaced under /Q/ rather than a bare /** rewrite, which would swallow every 404 in the app.

headers.//: Always revalidate app code so a deploy shows up immediately instead of hiding behind a stale browser cache (the 1-hour default bit us during setup). Data is live regardless; this only affects the HTML/JS/JSON shell.

Fonts, icons and the sample molds are content-addressed by name and effectively immutable; cache them hard so the app loads instantly on repeat visits and works offline. Samples are fetched on demand, never at page load, so they cost nothing until someone tries one.
